scope: P0-12 local delivery of opt-in signed database update operations

delivery.transport: Cloud Scheduler OAuth to pinned-source Cloud Build controller

policy.build_source_lifecycle: new private regional operations bucket; build-sources/ only, seven days

safety.source: approved git archive, application fingerprint and GCS generation pinned
safety.installation_default: private state disabled; Scheduler paused; alert policies disabled
safety.activation: separate explicit enable after verified initial health, with a post-policy-change tick
safety.checks: official database signatures, clean/EICAR offline controls, immutable registry readback, nonregressing daily timestamp/version and image-only Job configuration comparison
safety.recovery: private generation-conditional intents; no time-expiry lease takeover; previous controller must be proven terminal
safety.uncertain_publication: campaign preserved; no blind build resubmission
safety.uncertain_deletion: absence readback may confirm; still-present version is not deleted again
safety.retention: only ledger-owned exact digests with matching release tags; protect current, rollback, pending and all Cloud Run references
safety.manual_deployment: pause, wait for controller/candidate completion, then approve new source separately; cross-feature adoption is not implemented in this batch
safety.public_output: validated metadata and fixed reason codes; raw Job/checkpoint/notification labels remain private

monitoring.aggregation: sum across Cloud Build IDs before alert evaluation

bounded owned-image selection, reference protection and uncertain deletion

local_validation.ruff_worker_configuration: passed for ten new Python files
local_validation.provider_schema_review: Cloud Build, Cloud Scheduler, GCS and Monitoring REST schemas and Cloud SDK staging calls checked; no live provider request verification
